column2: Vinod s/o Ganpatrao Nichat v. State of Maharashtra
column12: Whether a 9-year-old's account of being touched by a neighbour, backed only by her mother, was enough despite her epilepsy and a claimed enmity.
column13: Yes. The child and mother were consistent, the report was prompt, and the enmity defence was unproved; conviction and sentence upheld.

column13: Only after foundational facts are proved beyond reasonable doubt; the child's evidence was tutored and unsupported by medical proof, so 20-year sentence set aside.
